dataset.name: ibm_aml_hi_small
dataset.label_definition: positive = the (bank, account) entity is the payer or the payee of at least one transaction whose published 'Is Laundering' flag is 1. IBM labels transactions; this entity label is derived, and it makes a launderer's counterparty positive as well
notes: SYNTHETIC: IBM AMLworld virtual-world simulator (Altman et al., NeurIPS 2023 Datasets and Benchmarks). Not evidence about real-world detection.
Entity is the (bank, account) pair; account strings are not globally unique (8 collisions across banks).
Amounts are native across 15 currencies (37% USD) and are not FX-converted; the amount column is 'amount', not 'amount_usd'.
The typology names live in the separate HI-Small_Patterns.txt and are deliberately not loaded: their group headers state the generating mechanism and its degree/hop parameter.
Version is derived from file size and mtime, not a content hash; the content hash is in data/manifests/ibm_aml_hi_small.json.
